diagnostic.purpose: Reduce/measure opaque overdraw on the river/village map without changing selected geometry. No handset FPS claim.
diagnostic.map: old sym9 village/river map from immutable Tex3 parent: maps/kordos/kordos.3d, baked lightmap/kordod.vla, Tex3 slots forest/map-selo1/river
diagnostic.selection: same GRID selector and same selected faces in every mode; BVH explicitly OFF

modes.key1: A LARGE: original per-material large VertexBuffers, original order (control)
modes.key3: C ORIG: compact <=512-corner spatial packets, original order
modes.key7: C F2B: same compact packets/calls, opaque packets sorted front-to-back by nearest AABB depth
modes.key9: C ZPRE: C F2B plus depth-only prepass (color/alpha write off), then color pass with depth write off; river pass unchanged
modes.key0: cycle A -> C ORIG -> C F2B -> C ZPRE
modes.star: freeze/show full counters; press again to resume with fresh warmup

diagnostic.hud: live measurement uses only two lines (mode/FPS and N/R/I); full counters only in frozen result
diagnostic.packet_sort: stable insertion sort of selected opaque compact packets by nearest world-AABB depth along camera forward; sorting cost is in J/prepare, no per-frame index or vertex allocation
diagnostic.depth_prepass: JSR-184 CompositingMode color/alpha write masks; cutout parts keep texture+alpha threshold in depth pass, fully opaque parts use no texture there; M3G depth test is LEQUAL so the color pass can pass at equal depth
diagnostic.m3g_compatibility: Target user-reported Nokia E65 M3G 1.0: no M3G 1.1 OVERWRITE hint/getters or new renderer APIs; color/alpha write masks and LEQUAL depth are JSR-184 1.0 features, still to be verified on handset
diagnostic.alpha: original per-image thresholds ON in color passes; no alpha-disable control
diagnostic.depth: test ON; write ON for opaque color/prepass as specified per mode, OFF for river
diagnostic.river: all 4 cached frames, speed6, mode7, original pass/order; excluded from depth prepass
diagnostic.pump: same worker repaint()+serviceRepaints()+sleep(1) in all modes
diagnostic.visual_risk: front-to-back packet order can change winners only for exactly/near coplanar overlapping faces; check for flicker/artifacts on handset
diagnostic.stats_note: J/B/K/R/E and N/C/I are Java API wall times, NOT GPU timestamps or proven LCD flips; VB counts actual submitted buffer capacities including both ZPRE passes

purpose: Isolated river-map overdraw A/B: large vs compact packets, front-to-back packet submission, and optional M3G depth prepass.
